events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Album Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic album "Imagine" was released on this day in 1971.

angles.name: Imagine The Impact
angles.copy: More than just a song, it's an anthem. Today marks the anniversary of John Lennon's timeless 'Imagine' album. Still inspiring generations.

events.title: Sting turns 75
events.blurb: Musician Sting, known for his work with The Police and as a solo artist, celebrates his 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Sting
angles.copy: Turning 75 today, Sting continues to prove that some artists just get better with age. Happy birthday to a true music legend!

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: Today is James Bond Day, marking the 1962 premiere of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No'.

angles.name: Shaken Not Stirred
angles.copy: Shaken, not stirred. It's James Bond Day! Celebrating 007's enduring legacy since 'Dr. No' premiered on this day in '62.

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Legendary musician and peace activist John Lennon would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Remembering Lennon
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message continue to resonate globally.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Comedic icon John Cleese, co-founder of Monty Python and star of Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: And now for something completely different... Happy 87th birthday to the one and only John Cleese! A true master of British comedy.

events.title: First iPod released
events.blurb: Apple introduced the very first iPod on this day in 2001, revolutionising portable music players.

angles.name: Pocket Full of Tunes
angles.copy: Remember your first iPod? Today marks 25 years since Apple put 1,000 songs in our pockets, changing music forever.

events.title: The Beatles' "White Album" Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic self-titled double album, commonly known as "The White Album," on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Legacy
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles unveiled their sprawling, self-titled masterpiece. The 'White Album' still sounds as revolutionary today.

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Today marks the 35th anniversary of the passing of legendary Queen frontman, Freddie Mercury.

angles.name: Freddie's Legacy
angles.copy: Thirty-five years since we lost a voice like no other. Remembering the incomparable Freddie Mercury, whose legacy continues to rock the world.

events.title: The Beatles' "Rubber Soul" Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album "Rubber Soul" on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Impact
angles.copy: A pivotal moment in pop history. Today marks the anniversary of The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul,' an album that changed everything.

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the tragic passing of John Lennon in 1980.

angles.name: Lennon's Enduring Spirit
angles.copy: Forty-six years ago today, the world lost a visionary. Remembering John Lennon, whose spirit of peace and music lives on.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: The iconic musician David Bowie would have celebrated his 80th birthday today.

angles.name: Bowie's Legacy
angles.copy: Forever changing the sound and look of music. Remembering David Bowie on what would have been his 80th birthday.

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: The King of Rock & Roll, Elvis Presley, would have celebrated his 92nd birthday today.

angles.name: Long Live The King
angles.copy: Long live the King! Elvis Presley would have turned 92 today, and his music still reigns supreme.

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Legendary Led Zeppelin guitarist Jimmy Page celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: Eighty-three years young and still a guitar god. Happy birthday to the legendary Led Zeppelin axe-man, Jimmy Page!

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: Sir Rod Stewart, the iconic British singer, celebrates his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Rod The Mod
angles.copy: From the Faces to solo stardom, Rod the Mod is still going strong! Happy 82nd birthday to Sir Rod Stewart.

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Graham "Suggs" McPherson, the charismatic frontman of Madness, celebrates his 66th birthday today.

angles.name: Our House, Our Suggs
angles.copy: Our house, in the middle of our street... It's Suggs' 66th birthday! Wishing the Madness frontman a truly fantastic day.
